crossRefs.note: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which…
“ ‘If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them,
Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with them…
He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”
to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,

translations.web: It shall happen, because you listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, that Yahweh your God will keep with you the covenant and the loving kindness which he swore to your fathers.
translations.bsb: If you listen to these ordinances and keep them carefully, then the LORD your God will keep His covenant and the loving devotion that He swore to your fathers.
translations.kjv: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:
translations.asv: And it shall come to pass, because ye hearken to these ordinances, and keep and do them, that Jehovah thy God will keep with thee the covenant and the lovingkindness which he sware unto thy fathers:
